_about: Policy for the golden regression harness. Every threshold, param, and rule lives HERE — run_golden.py contains no hardcoded numbers or circuit-specific logic. Tune here, not in Python.

gate._about: How invariant violations affect the exit code. 'regression' (default): the exit-code gate is BASELINE DRIFT only — a known-good snapshot is whatever the engine produces today, and any invariant violation already present in the committed baseline is reported as a KNOWN quality issue (loudly, at --update time) rather than blocking the net. 'strict': ANY invariant violation also fails the gate (use once the engine produces zero violations). This keeps the safety net seedable + green today while never silently blessing a defect.

universal_invariants._about: Quality bar applied to EVERY golden fixture (a golden fixture is, by definition, a known-good circuit). Under gate.mode='regression' a violation here is a reported KNOWN issue; under 'strict' it fails the gate. A fixture may relax/override any of these via its own optional 'expected' block (used by intentional-defect fixtures).

selector_params._about: Geometry-selector kwargs. Mirrors config/lint_rules.json defaults; kept here so the harness is self-contained and tunable without touching the lint engine.

canonicalize._about: Keys dropped (at any nesting depth) from the render-stats snapshot before hashing/diffing — they carry absolute paths / per-run values that are not connectivity. Anything matching abs_path_regex is also dropped.

netlist_hash._about: Two-tier connectivity fingerprint. Tier 1 = post-normalize IR net->pin adjacency (pure-python, always). Tier 2 = `kicad-cli sch export netlist` of the rendered file (the ground truth KiCad sees), enabled only when kicad-cli is discoverable on PATH.
